WITH filtered_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_coupon_amt, cs_sales_price, cs_net_profit, c_birth_year, cd1.cd_dep_count
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
    JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN' ,'GA','MT','IN','CA')
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
),
aggregated_data AS (
    SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county,
           AVG(CAST(cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1,
           AVG(CAST(cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,
           AVG(CAST(cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3,
           AVG(CAST(cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4,
           AVG(CAST(cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5,
           AVG(CAST(c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6,
           AVG(CAST(cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg7
    FROM filtered_catalog_sales
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
)
SELECT * FROM aggregated_data
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
